verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents error status actions with fixed/snoozed/ignored states (mute/ignore rules) and event-usage controls that let teams limit which events count toward quota, plus PagerDuty/Slack alert routing. However there is no evidence of true 'spike protection' (automatic surge suppression) or per-key/per-error rate limiting to prevent alert storms during a bad deploy. missing for 10: explicit spike protection feature, per-key rate limiting, deploy-aware alert throttling, independent confirmation these noise-control tools work as intended.
